name: Zhask
story: King of the Swarm who disrupts the balance of the universe.

skills.name: Decimation
skills.desc: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied Nightmaric Spawn on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

skills.name: Nightmaric Spawn
skills.desc: Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that inherits 55% of his Attributes (HP, Hybrid Defense, and Magic Power). It automatically attacks nearby enemies by firing a Death Ray, dealing 55 (+20% extra Attack Speed) (+20% Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by up to 30%. It disappears if Zhask is too far away. Death Ray is considered a Basic Attack but cannot Crit. Fusion Enhanced: The damage of Nightmaric Spawn is increased to 180%, and it can be repositioned.

skills.name: Mind Eater
skills.desc: Zhask fires a penetrating psychic beam in the target direction, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Afterward, the Nightmaric Spawn attacks enemies hit by Mind Eater, dealing 120 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.5s. Fusion Enhanced: Mind Eater damage is increased to 540 (+180% Total Magic Power).

skills.name: Hive Clones
skills.desc: Zhask releases a swarm of Hive Clones in the target direction. The clones explode upon hitting an enemy, dealing 55 (+18% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1s. If the Hive Clones hit no target, they burrow into the ground to ambush passing enemies. Fusion Enhanced: Zhask releases several swarms of Hive Clones. Subsequent damage to the same target decays to 20%.

skills.name: Dominator's Descent
skills.desc: Zhask selects a target area to summon an enhanced Nightmaric Spawn and fuses with it. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra attributes. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period. Use Again: Zhask immediately gets off the Nightmaric Spawn and loses enhancement.
